content.value_statement: Adding multilingual support often scatters strings, routing, metadata, and locale files across the codebase. This skill plans and implements i18n setup with translations, validation, and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Detects common web frameworks and selects next-intl, react-i18next, or vue-i18n guidance.
Designs nested or flat translation key structures for pages and shared UI.
Creates locale file plans for JSON, YAML, PO, or XLIFF workflows.
Guides language switcher, locale routing, SEO metadata, and sitemap localization.
Includes RTL checks for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian layouts.
limitations: AI translations still need native speaker review before production release.
Package installation requires user approval in controlled environments.
It does not replace a translation management system for large teams.
Custom frameworks may need manual integration choices.

use_cases.title: Launch Multilingual Pages
use_cases.description: Add translated routes, metadata, and locale files for a marketing site.

use_cases.title: Prepare MVP Translations
use_cases.description: Generate first-pass translations and validation tasks for a product release.

use_cases.title: Standardize Locale Structure
use_cases.description: Create consistent key naming, file organization, and review steps across locales.

prompt_templates.title: Translate Basic UI
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small React app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate my React app to Spanish and French. Create a simple key structure and locale files for shared buttons and homepage text.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Next.js i18n
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup with routing and metadata.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up next-intl for my Next.js app with English, Japanese, and Arabic. Include routing, metadata, and a language switcher.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Existing Localization
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing i18n implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my existing i18n setup for missing keys, broken placeholders, RTL layout issues, and SEO gaps. Return prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Scalable Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert workflow planning for a larger product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scalable localization workflow with namespaces, fallback rules, translation review steps, and documentation for adding languages.

output_examples.input: A Next.js marketing site needs English, Japanese, and Spanish.
output_examples.output: A plan with next-intl setup, locale routing, translated metadata, message files, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: A React dashboard already uses hardcoded labels.
output_examples.output: A refactor outline with key namespaces, extracted strings, locale file coverage, and language switcher tasks.
An RTL checklist covering direction settings, logical CSS, mirrored layouts, and locale-specific testing.

best_practices: Keep translation keys stable and grouped by page or shared component.
Preserve placeholders and plural rules during every translation pass.
Review production translations with native speakers before release.
anti_patterns: Do not mix hardcoded user-facing strings with translated UI.
Do not use machine translations without review for legal or checkout flows.
Do not ignore RTL layout testing when adding Arabic, Hebrew, or Persian.

faq.question: Which frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for Next.js, React, Vue, and adaptable web projects.

faq.question: Can it install i18n libraries?
faq.answer: It can suggest and help run installation steps when the user approves command execution.

faq.question: Does it provide production-quality translations?
faq.answer: It can draft translations, but production releases should include native speaker review.

faq.question: Can it handle RTL languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for direction, logical CSS, mirrored layouts, and validation.

faq.question: Does it support SEO localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers translated metadata, hreflang alternates, canonical URLs, and localized sitemaps.

faq.question: Can it work with existing locale files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze current keys, identify gaps, and recommend updates.
